definitions.explanation: A type of recurring headache characterized by intense, throbbing pain, usually on one side of the head.

examples.japanese: {偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
{偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the weather changes, I tend to get migraines more easily.

notes:
Written with ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧ (one-sided) and ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧ (headache), reflecting the characteristic one-sided pain. The medical term is {片頭痛|へんずつう}, using the kanji {片|へん} instead of ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧, but both writings are widely used. In medical literature, {片頭痛|へんずつう} is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}{持|も}ち: someone who suffers from migraines
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to get a migraine
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: migraine attack
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: migraine medication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧: headache — the general term for any headache
- {片頭痛|へんずつう}: migraine — the standard medical spelling with {片|へん}
- {緊張型|きんちょうがた}⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧: tension headache — a different type of headache caused by muscle tension
